name: foundry-stack
description: A modular Laravel + React baseline for internal management systems.
author: Gerardo Sanchez <gschz.git@gmail.com>

scripts.i:all: bun i && bun run be i && bun run fe i
scripts.dev: bun run --parallel 'bun run be dev' 'bun run be ql' 'bun run fe dev' 'bun run mailpit'
scripts.dk:start: bun run --parallel 'bun run dk:up:fg' 'bun run dev:fe:dk'
scripts.dev:fe:dk: bun run --env-file ./.envs/.env.docker -- bun run fe dev
scripts.dk:artisan: bun run dk exec backend php artisan
scripts.dk:sh: bun run dk exec backend sh
scripts.pg:dev: bun run --parallel 'bun run be pg:dev' 'bun run be pg:ql' 'bun run fe dev' 'bun run mailpit'
